lines.t: When the morning light was breaking,
I could feel a brand new start.
All the weight that I had carried
Started lifting off my heart.
In the middle of my questions,
Hope came shining like the sun.
That was when I really noticed,
YahuShua, You’re the faithful One.
Every step I thought was random
Turned to purpose in Your hands.
Looking back I see Your goodness
Written in my every plan.
(Jin-shi-mo-ro) I believe it.
You were right on time when I needed You most,
Turning all my fears into a song of hope.
You were right on time when my heart felt weak,
Filling up my days with a joy so deep.
In the middle of my story,
You were making all things new.
Every smile, every breath I have,
YahuShua, it’s because of You.
In the laughter with my family,
In the sunlight on my face,
In the quiet evening moments,
I can feel Your loving grace.
You were guiding me so gently,
Even when I couldn’t see.
Now my eyes are wide and open,
YahuShua, You’ve been good to me.
All the doors that You kept closing
Led me to a better place.
Now I dance inside the freedom
Of Your never-failing grace.
(Yeong-won-hee) Always.
You were right on time when I needed You most,
Turning all my fears into a song of hope.
You were right on time when my heart felt weak,
Filling up my days with a joy so deep.
In the middle of my story,
You were making all things new.
Every smile, every breath I have,
YahuShua, it’s because of You.
[Bridge - Male & Female Call and Response]
(Male) You turned my worry into worship,
(Female) You turned my waiting into praise.
(Male) Every season that was heavy
(Female) Now is filled with brighter days.
(Duet) In the valley, on the hillside,
On my walks beneath the sky,
YahuShua, You are with me,
You’re my joy that never dies.
You were there with perfect peace.
YahuShua, when I needed You,
Your good plans were blessing me.
You were right on time when I needed You most,
Pouring out Your love on my thirsty soul.
You were right on time when my strength ran low,
Lifting me up so I could grow.
In the middle of my story,
Every dream, every step I take,
YahuShua, I will trust in You.
You were right on time, and You’re still here every day.
YahuShua, my forever Friend, I follow in Your way.
From the sunrise to the starlight, You are faithful, good, and true.
Gam-sa-ham-ni-da (Thank You), it’s all for You.
You were there when I needed You...
You are here in every smile.
YahuShua... my joy...
(Ooh, ooh...)
[End]
